content:
One of my favourite Apple TV 4K features—the screensaver—could get sound effects starting with tvOS 27, according to the latest leaked information. Here are the details.

tvOS 27 code shows that at least one Apple TV screensaver will be getting an audio option, with more expected

October is shaping up to be a significant month for Apple, with plenty of new hardware and software products set to launch.

A new Apple TV 4K is reportedly one of them, with a leaked image appearing in Apple code earlier today.

On the software side, leaker pdfu has just published evidence from the tvOS 27 codebase, showing that at least one Apple TV screensaver is set to gain sound effects.

As seen in the video above, the Snoopy screensaver has a hidden option to turn sound effects on or off, or use a "reduced" setting.

Using the Snoopy screensaver as an example, it doesn't look like it should be too distracting, but I'm glad Apple plans to let users turn the sound off entirely.

Although pdfu hasn't yet found audio support in other screensavers, there's a good chance Apple will expand this feature to more screensavers in the future.

What do you think about tvOS 27 potentially adding sound options to Apple TV screensavers? Share your thoughts in the comments.
